items.source: If @SqlMergeMode is not declared on a test class or test method, SqlMergeMode.MergeMode.OVERRIDE will be used by default.
items.translation: 如果未在测试类或测试方法上声明`@SqlMergeMode`，则默认将使用SqlMergeMode.MergeMode.OVERRIDE。

items.source: A method-level @SqlMergeMode declaration overrides a class-level declaration.
items.translation: 方法级别的@SqlMergeMode声明会覆盖类级别的声明。

items.source: Indicates whether method-level @Sql annotations should be merged with class-level @Sql annotations or override them.
items.translation: 指示是否应将方法级别的 `@Sql` 注解与类级别的 `@Sql` 注解合并，还是覆盖它们。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations with attribute overrides.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建具有属性覆盖的自定义 组合注解。

items.source: This annotation will be inherited from an enclosing test class by default. See @NestedTestConfiguration for details.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此注解将从外部测试类继承。有关详细信息，请参阅 @NestedTestConfiguration。

items.source: Enumeration of modes that dictate whether method-level @Sql declarations are merged with class-level @Sql declarations.
items.translation: 枚举模式，用于规定是否将方法级别的@Sql声明与类级别的@Sql声明合并。
